short.en: Repair doors, hardware, wall linings and fixed joinery.
short.zh: 安排门扇、五金、墙板及固定木作维修。

intro.en: We bring everyday building repairs into one clear scope: damaged walls and ceilings, loose fittings, door hardware and fixed joinery. We agree access with your site manager and organise the work around the areas your tenants, staff and guests need to keep using.
intro.zh: 我们把墙面吊顶破损、固定件松动、门五金及固定木作等日常维修整理成明确范围，与现场负责人确认进场时间，并按租户、员工和住客的通行需求安排施工。

kicker.en: The details that keep a building working
kicker.zh: 让建筑正常运转的每处细节

deck.en: Doors that close, walls made good and a defect list brought into one workable plan.
deck.zh: 把门五金、墙面吊顶和固定木作的缺陷，整理成一份可执行的维修计划。

lead.en: We repair the everyday building defects that interrupt an otherwise busy property. A single damaged door and a list across several tenancies need different preparation. We identify each location, check the surrounding construction and agree the repair and finish before organising attendance.
lead.zh: 我们处理商业物业日常使用中的建筑缺陷。单扇门损坏与多个租区的集中维修，需要不同的材料和进场安排。我们逐项记录位置，检查周边构造，并在安排施工前明确修复范围与饰面要求。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast building maintenance for door hardware, walls, ceilings and fixed joinery, with clear scopes, finish matching and occupied-site arrangements.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸建筑与日常维护，处理门五金、墙面吊顶及固定木作，明确维修范围、饰面匹配、营业中施工和完工交付。

title.en: Start with the defect, then check what sits around it
title.zh: 从缺陷本身，检查到周边构造

title.en: A door rubs or will not latch

text.en: We check the leaf, hinges, frame, latch and closer together. Loose hardware and a damaged fixing need a different repair from a distorted door or frame.
text.zh: 我们一起检查门扇、铰链、门框、锁舌和闭门器。五金松动、固定点损坏与门体或门框变形，需要不同的处理。

title.en: A wall or ceiling is damaged

text.en: We establish the affected area, board or surface condition and what must be removed. A water-stained ceiling also needs its moisture source addressed before the final finish is reinstated.
text.zh: 我们核对受影响面积、板材及表面状况，确定需要拆除的部分。存在水渍的吊顶还需处理进水来源，再安排最终饰面恢复。

text.en: We inspect the fixing points, supporting material and matching parts. The scope distinguishes adjusting or securing an item from replacing damaged components.
text.zh: 我们检查固定点、支承材料和配件匹配情况，将调整、重新固定与受损部件更换分别列清。

title.en: One repair, a grouped visit or a larger refresh
title.zh: 单项维修、集中处理或较大翻新

rows.en: A closer, damaged panel or local patch.
rows.zh: 闭门器、破损面板或局部修补。

rows.en: Numbered defects across rooms or tenancies.
rows.zh: 跨房间或租区的编号缺陷清单。

rows.en: Location, quantities and a practical sequence.
Repeated repairs or a shared-area update.
rows.zh: 重复缺陷处理或公共区域更新。

rows.en: Retained elements, finish boundaries and stages.
rows.zh: 保留部分、饰面边界和阶段。

title.en: Match the repair to the existing building

text.en: We confirm the existing build-up and sound fixing areas before choosing replacement material. Repair dimensions and adjacent damage determine how far the work extends.
text.zh: 我们确认现有构造和牢固的固定位置，再选择更换材料。修补尺寸及相邻损伤决定施工延伸范围。

text.en: We use available product details and site samples to discuss matching. The quote identifies where a local finish is suitable and where a larger visible surface needs attention.
text.zh: 我们结合现有产品资料和现场样本确认匹配方式。报价中说明局部饰面处理范围，以及需要扩大处理的可见表面。

paragraphs.en: We check hinge and lock patterns, board type, finish colour and sheen. Matching an aged surface, ordering uncommon hardware or opening up concealed backing can change the quote. We confirm these items before allowing for patching, joint treatment and finishing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们核对合页和锁具规格、板材种类、颜色与光泽。旧饰面配色、特殊五金订货或打开隐蔽基层都可能改变报价。确认后再安排修补、接缝处理和饰面恢复。

title.en: From protection to a working finish
title.zh: 从现场保护到功能恢复

text.en: We confirm the agreed item list and protect adjacent floors, furniture and finishes before opening or removing affected material.
text.zh: 我们核对约定项目，保护周边地面、家具和饰面，再拆开或移除受损材料。

text.en: We address the fixing or substrate, install the agreed parts, and complete the specified patching and finishing stages.
text.zh: 我们处理固定点或基层，安装确认的配件，并完成约定的修补和饰面工序。

text.en: We check door operation or the repaired surface, clear the agreed work area and record any remaining item requiring separate approval.
text.zh: 我们检查门的运行或修复表面，清理约定区域，并记录需要另行确认的剩余项目。

title.en: Work around the people using the space

paragraphs.en: We agree keys, room access, noise and dust-producing tasks with your representative. Shared corridors need a usable route, while a painted or repaired surface may need time before furniture returns. These arrangements belong in the work plan, alongside any return visit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与负责人确认钥匙、房间进出、噪音及扬尘工序。公共走廊需安排通行路线，修复或刷漆后的表面需结合材料条件恢复家具使用；这些内容与再次进场需求一并写入计划。

text.en: The number of locations, repair area, height, substrate condition and matching materials define the labour and material allowance.
text.zh: 位置数量、修复面积、高度、基层现状和匹配材料决定人工与材料范围。

text.en: We itemise agreed protection, access equipment, waste and return visits, so a small repair is not confused with a complete room refurbishment.
text.zh: 我们列明约定保护、登高设备、废物和回访施工，将局部维修与整间翻新清楚区分。

title.en: A clear record against your list

paragraphs.en: We identify completed items by room, location or defect number. The handover records the agreed finish and operation checks, available completion photos and any parts or separate works still outstanding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按房间、位置或缺陷编号标明完成项目，记录约定的饰面和运行检查、相应完工照片，以及仍待配件或另行安排的工作。

q.en: Does a sticking door always need replacing?
q.zh: 门扇卡住一定要更换整扇门吗？

a.en: No. We first check alignment, hinges, fixings, latch and closer. Adjustment or hardware repair may address the issue; damaged door construction or frame conditions can require a different scope.
a.zh: 不一定。我们先检查门的对位、铰链、固定点、锁舌与闭门器，区分可以调整或维修的五金问题，以及需要处理门体或门框的情况。

q.en: Can several small jobs be quoted together?
q.zh: 多项小维修可以合并报价吗？

a.en: Yes. A numbered list with locations and photos helps us confirm quantities and materials. We group practical tasks and identify anything needing separate access, parts or a later finish stage.
a.zh: 可以。带位置、编号和照片的清单有助于确认数量及材料。我们合并可一起进行的工作，列明需要单独进场、订件或后续饰面处理的项目。

q.en: Can you repair the ceiling after a leak?
q.zh: 漏水后的吊顶可以一起修复吗？

a.en: We can include agreed ceiling repairs and finishing. We separate the moisture-source work from reinstatement and check the affected material before confirming the repair boundary.
a.zh: 可以纳入确认的吊顶与饰面修复。我们将进水源头处理和恢复工程分开，并检查受影响材料后确认修补边界。

short.en: Check roof junctions, gutter overflow and signs of water entry.
short.zh: 核对屋面节点、天沟溢流和渗水迹象。

intro.en: We investigate where water enters and how it travels through the building before defining the repair. Our scope can include commercial roof repairs, box gutters, flashings, penetrations and waterproofing details. For coastal properties, we check the existing material, exposed fixings and signs of salt-related deterioration.
intro.zh: 我们先检查进水位置及水在建筑中的路径，再确定修复范围。工作可涉及商业屋面、箱形天沟、泛水、穿屋面节点及防水收口；海边物业同时核对现有材料、外露固定件和盐雾环境下的损耗。

kicker.en: Follow the water. Define the repair.
kicker.zh: 沿着水路，确定修复范围

deck.en: Commercial roofs, gutters and waterproofing details assessed as parts of the same building.
deck.zh: 把商业屋面、天沟和防水节点放在同一建筑水路中核对。

lead.en: We investigate the reported leak before selecting a repair. The visible stain, the roof above it and the drainage route can tell different parts of the story. We connect those observations, define accessible investigation and set out the material and access requirements for the agreed work.
lead.zh: 我们先排查漏水现象，再选择修复方法。可见水渍、上方屋面与排水路径提供的信息各不相同；我们结合这些观察，明确可开展的检查，并列出修复所需材料与进场条件。

metaDescription.en: Commercial roof and waterproofing repairs on the Gold Coast: leak investigation, sheets, flashings, box gutters, compatible materials and clear work scopes.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业屋顶与防水维修，涵盖漏水排查、屋面板、泛水、箱形天沟、材料匹配及明确的施工交付范围。

title.en: Tell us when the water appears
title.zh: 从漏水发生的条件开始

text.en: We record the affected rooms, weather conditions and previous repairs, then inspect accessible roof details and drainage. The stain location alone does not identify the entry point.
text.zh: 我们记录受影响房间、风雨条件和既往修补，再检查可到达的屋面节点与排水部位；水渍位置本身不能直接确定进水点。

text.en: We check penetrations, flashings, adjoining sheets and fixings together. A patch applied to one joint may leave neighbouring deterioration or a different water path unresolved.
text.zh: 我们一起检查穿屋面节点、泛水、相邻板材和固定件，避免只处理一条接缝而遗漏邻近损耗或其他进水路径。

title.en: Overflow or water below a terrace

text.en: We distinguish roof drainage from balcony or terrace waterproofing. Outlets, surface falls, joints and the existing waterproofing build-up inform the investigation scope.
text.zh: 我们区分屋面排水与阳台、露台防水问题，结合出水口、表面坡度、接缝和现有防水构造确定检查范围。

title.en: Local repair or a wider scope?
title.zh: 局部修复，还是扩大范围？

rows.en: A defined defect with usable surrounding material.
rows.zh: 缺陷明确，周边材料可继续使用。

rows.en: Preparation, adjoining joints and repair limits.
rows.zh: 基层处理、相邻接缝与修复边界。

rows.en: Deteriorated sheets, flashings or gutter sections.
rows.zh: 板材、泛水或部分天沟损耗。

rows.en: Connections to retained work and drainage.
rows.zh: 与保留部分及排水的衔接。

rows.en: The condition extends beyond a reliable local repair.
rows.zh: 现状超出可靠局部修复范围。

title.zh: 把材料兼容性写进范围

text.en: We identify the existing metal, coating, fasteners and adjoining materials. Exposed and sheltered coastal locations inform the condition assessment; product guidance applies to the actual material being used.
text.zh: 我们识别现有金属、涂层、固定件和相邻材料，结合沿海暴露或遮蔽位置评估状态；产品要求对应实际采用的材料。

text.en: We confirm the existing system, substrate and relevant junctions before defining repairs. Surface finishes, removal and reinstatement are itemised where they form part of the work.
text.zh: 我们核对现有系统、基层及相关交接节点，再确认防水修复。涉及表面饰面、拆除或恢复时，分别列入工作范围。

title.en: A repair sequence tied to the fault
title.zh: 围绕故障安排施工顺序

text.en: We map the reported leak and accessible defects, identifying any investigation that needs separate access or opening-up.
text.zh: 我们对应漏水现象和可见缺陷，列明需要单独进场或拆开检查的部分。

text.en: We prepare the agreed area, address the specified detail and connect the repair to sound retained material using the confirmed system.
text.zh: 我们处理约定区域，修复指定节点，并按确认系统与牢固的保留材料衔接。

text.en: We complete the checks appropriate to the agreed scope and record treated locations, junctions and follow-up observations.
text.zh: 我们完成与约定范围相符的检查，记录处理位置、节点及后续观察事项。

title.en: Plan the roof and the occupied space below
title.zh: 同时安排屋面与下方使用空间

paragraphs.en: Height, roof access, weather and the space below all affect staging. We agree material movement, work-area separation and protection for stock, rooms or workstations. Any temporary arrangement and subsequent interior repairs are identified in the scope rather than assumed to be part of the roof item.
paragraphs.zh: 高度、屋面到达方式、天气和下方用途都会影响分段安排。我们确认材料运输、作业隔离及存货、客房或工位保护；临时安排和后续室内恢复分别列清。

title.en: What we need to price the work

text.en: Repair area, roof geometry, height, equipment access and the extent of concealed deterioration affect the work required.
text.zh: 修复面积、屋面构造、高度、设备进场及隐藏损耗范围影响所需工作。

text.en: We identify gutter cleaning, drainage repairs, removal, waste and internal reinstatement separately when they are part of the brief.
text.zh: 需求涉及天沟清理、排水维修、拆除、废物或室内恢复时，我们分别列项。

q.en: Why can a leak return after sealant was applied?
q.zh: 为什么打胶后仍然漏水？

a.en: The earlier patch may not address the entry point, adjoining defects, drainage or the condition beneath it. We review the previous work and the leak pattern before defining a further repair.
a.zh: 原修补可能未处理真正进水点、相邻缺陷、排水或下方现状。我们核对既往处理和漏水条件，再确定后续修复。

q.en: Can roof and gutter work be considered together?
q.zh: 屋顶和天沟能一起核对吗？

a.en: Yes. We review relevant roof details, gutters, outlets and accessible drainage connections together. Work on downstream pipework is clearly identified and coordinated with the drainage scope.
a.zh: 可以。我们结合屋面节点、天沟、出水口和可检查的排水连接核对，下游管线工作明确列入排水范围并协调。

q.en: Can the premises remain occupied?
q.zh: 施工期间物业可以继续使用吗？

a.en: We assess access, the area below the work and weather-sensitive stages with your manager. The plan identifies usable areas, necessary closures and any interior protection or separate attendance.
a.zh: 我们与负责人核对到达条件、作业下方区域和受天气影响的工序，明确可使用区域、必要封闭、室内保护及单独进场安排。

q.en: Does a leaking commercial roof always need replacing?
q.zh: 商业屋顶漏水一定要全部更换吗？

a.en: We assess the roof condition, the leak source and the extent of deterioration first. We then set out whether a local repair, a wider repair scope or replacement addresses the problem, with the relevant access and material requirements.
a.zh: 我们先检查屋面状况、漏水源头和损耗范围，再明确局部修补、扩大修复或更换的处理方案，并列出相应材料与进场要求。

short.en: Lighting, fittings and electrical maintenance for working premises.
short.zh: 为营业中的商业场所安排电气与照明维护。

intro.en: We plan commercial electrical and lighting work around how each area is used. We identify affected fittings and circuits, confirm the required isolation and coordinate access with your manager. Outdoor and coastal lighting needs a check of the fitting specification, exposure and mounting condition.
intro.zh: 我们根据各区域的使用方式安排商业电气和照明工作，核对相关灯具及回路、确认断电范围，并与物业负责人协调进场。室外及海边照明同时检查灯具规格、暴露环境和安装固定状况。

kicker.en: Light the work. Keep the plan clear.
kicker.zh: 照亮工作空间，明确维护安排

deck.en: Lighting faults, fittings and upgrades planned around the way each commercial area operates.
deck.zh: 根据每个商业区域的实际用途，安排照明故障、配件维修与升级。

lead.en: We organise electrical and lighting maintenance by affected area, existing equipment and required isolation. A flickering fitting, failed control and wider lighting upgrade need different scopes. We identify the equipment involved and agree the sequence before arranging the work.
lead.zh: 我们按受影响区域、现有设备和停用要求安排电气与照明维护。灯具闪烁、控制失效与整片区域升级的范围不同，我们先核对相关设备，再确认施工顺序。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial electrical and lighting maintenance, with fault scopes, fitting and control compatibility, access planning and functional handover.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业电气与照明维护，明确故障范围、灯具与控制兼容性、进场停用及功能检查交付。

title.en: Describe the fault by area and behaviour
title.zh: 按区域和表现描述故障

text.en: We record the affected fittings, when the fault occurs and whether it changes with a control setting. The fitting, driver, control and circuit context are checked before replacement is defined.
text.zh: 我们记录涉及灯具、发生时间及故障是否随控制设置变化，核对灯具、驱动器、控制和回路情况后再确定更换。

title.en: A zone or control does not work

text.en: We identify which spaces and existing equipment are affected. This distinguishes a local component issue from work involving several fittings, controls or a broader interruption.
text.zh: 我们核对受影响空间与设备，区分单个部件问题和涉及多盏灯、控制系统或更大停用范围的工作。

text.en: We check the mounting, enclosure condition and exposure of entry or car park lighting. Replacement selection follows the location and existing installation, not appearance alone.
text.zh: 我们检查入口或停车区灯具的固定、外壳和暴露条件，结合安装位置及现有结构选配件。

title.en: Single fittings and planned lighting updates
title.zh: 单个灯具与计划性照明更新

rows.zh: 排查及确认的部件处理。

rows.en: Several fittings or areas on one list.
Agreed changes across a working area.
rows.zh: 工作区域内的照明调整。

rows.en: Use, retained fittings and existing controls.
rows.zh: 用途、保留灯具和现有控制。

title.en: Choose fittings as part of the installation
title.zh: 结合安装系统选择灯具

text.en: We check mounting dimensions, existing drivers and control requirements. Matching the visible fitting does not by itself confirm that the electrical and control arrangements are suitable.
text.zh: 我们核对安装尺寸、现有驱动器和控制要求；外观相同的灯具仍需确认电气与控制匹配。

text.en: We discuss the use of the space, existing light colour and practical access for maintenance. Outdoor exposure and equipment-specific instructions are included in selection where relevant.
text.zh: 我们结合空间用途、现有光色和检修可达性选型，并在相关位置纳入室外暴露及设备说明。

title.en: Agree the interruption before the work

text.en: We review the fault, equipment details and spaces served, then identify the investigation and replacement work to be included.
text.zh: 我们核对故障、设备和服务空间，明确排查与更换工作。

text.en: We agree the interruption with your manager, including affected occupants, ceiling access, high-level work and surrounding protection.
text.zh: 我们与负责人确认停用影响、使用人员、吊顶检修、高位作业和周边保护。

text.en: We check the agreed fitting and control operation and provide the relevant records for the work actually performed.
text.zh: 我们检查约定灯具和控制运行，交付与实际完成工作相应的资料。

title.en: A quotation tied to the actual installation

text.en: Quantity, height, product availability, wiring changes and the condition of retained components affect the scope. Investigation and wider upgrades are separately identified.
text.zh: 数量、高度、产品供应、线路调整和保留部件状况影响范围；排查与较大升级分别列明。

text.en: We confirm access equipment, trading windows, tenant coordination and any ceiling or finish reinstatement needed around the electrical work.
text.zh: 我们确认登高设备、营业窗口、租户协调及电气工作周边所需吊顶或饰面恢复。

title.en: Return the area with clear operating information
title.zh: 交还区域与清楚的操作信息

paragraphs.en: We identify completed locations and explain any agreed changes to controls. Handover records distinguish the items completed from further faults, unavailable parts or separately approved work. Where other building repairs follow, their boundaries and sequence remain clear.
paragraphs.zh: 我们标明完成位置，并说明约定的控制变化。交付记录区分已完成项目、后续故障、待供配件和另行确认工作；如需建筑恢复，明确其边界和顺序。

paragraphs.en: Mounting, exposure, light colour and dimming or sensor compatibility matter. Quantity, ceiling height, circuit alterations and making good after access all affect the quoted scope.
paragraphs.zh: 安装方式、使用环境、光色以及调光或感应兼容性都要核对。数量、吊顶高度、回路调整和打开后的恢复工作都会影响报价范围。

q.en: Does an LED flicker mean the whole fitting needs replacing?
q.zh: LED 闪烁需要换整盏灯吗？

a.en: Not necessarily. We check the fitting, driver and controls in their installation context. The repair scope identifies the component or fitting work supported by that assessment.
a.zh: 不一定。我们结合实际安装核对灯具、驱动器和控制，再确定相应部件或灯具的处理范围。

q.en: Can some areas continue operating?
q.zh: 可以保留部分区域继续营业吗？

a.en: We review the circuits, access and interruption requirements with your manager. Where the installation allows staged work, the plan identifies the areas available and unavailable at each stage.
a.zh: 我们与负责人核对回路、进场和停用要求；安装条件允许分区时，明确每阶段可用和暂停使用的区域。

q.en: What helps when requesting an outdoor lighting quote?
q.zh: 室外照明询价提供什么资料有帮助？

a.en: Send the location, number of fittings, approximate installation height and available model information or photos. We also need to understand access and how the surrounding area is used.
a.zh: 提供位置、灯具数量、大致高度、现有型号或照片，并说明到达条件及周边区域的使用方式。

q.en: Can existing dimming controls be retained?
q.zh: 原有调光控制能保留吗？

a.en: It depends on the fitting, driver and control compatibility. Provide model details so these can be checked before replacement is agreed.
a.zh: 要看灯具、驱动器与控制设备的相容性。请提供型号，便于确认替换前核对。

short.en: Leaks, hot water, drainage and agreed gas service work.
short.zh: 处理漏水、热水、排水及确认范围内的燃气服务。

intro.en: We investigate plumbing faults and define the affected service before arranging repairs. We cover agreed work to water supply, hot water, sanitary plumbing, drainage and gas systems, with clear separation between the immediate fault and any wider replacement work. We coordinate shutdowns with the people using the building.
intro.zh: 我们先排查水管故障并确认受影响的系统，再安排维修。范围包括已确认的供水、热水、卫生设施、排水及燃气工作，并区分当前故障处理与较大更换项目；涉及停水或停机时，我们与使用方协调。

kicker.en: Know the system before choosing the repair
kicker.zh: 先弄清系统，再确定修复

deck.en: Water, hot water and drainage faults organised around the facilities your premises needs.
deck.zh: 围绕物业实际使用的供水、热水与排水设施安排维修。

lead.en: We define the affected service before arranging plumbing work. A leaking fitting, loss of hot water and repeated drainage overflow require different investigation. We separate finding the fault from the final repair and agree the shutdown and access arrangements with the people operating the property.
lead.zh: 我们先明确受影响系统，再安排水管工作。配件漏水、热水不足和反复排水溢流需要不同排查；我们将故障调查与最终修复分开，并与物业使用方确认停用和进场。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial plumbing, hot water and drainage maintenance, with defined gas work, investigation scopes, shutdown planning and operating checks.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业水管、热水和排水维护，明确燃气工作、故障调查、停用安排及修复后的运行检查。

title.zh: 先确认哪套系统受影响

text.en: We record the leaking point, affected fixtures and when the problem occurs. Accessible valves, connections and surrounding damage help define investigation and the parts to be considered.
text.zh: 我们记录漏点、受影响设施和发生时间，结合可检查阀门、接头及周边损伤，确定排查与配件范围。

text.en: We review the equipment information, affected outlets and reported changes in supply. A local fixture problem and an equipment or wider supply issue should not be priced as the same repair.
text.zh: 我们核对设备资料、受影响出水点和供水变化，将单个设施问题与设备或较大供水问题分开。

text.en: We identify whether the issue occurs at one fixture, several connected points or an external drainage area. Timing during rain or normal use helps direct the investigation.
text.zh: 我们确认问题发生于单个设施、多个连接点还是室外排水区域，并结合降雨或正常使用时点安排排查。

title.zh: 把调查与修复分别说明

rows.en: Establish accessible conditions and the affected service.
rows.zh: 核对可见状况与受影响系统。

rows.en: Symptoms, records, access and agreed investigation.
rows.zh: 表现、记录、进场和约定检查。

rows.en: Address the identified fitting, connection or defect.
rows.zh: 处理确认的配件、接头或缺陷。

rows.en: Deal with a broader pipework or system issue.
rows.zh: 处理较大管线或系统问题。

rows.en: Further findings and separately confirmed work.
rows.zh: 补充发现及再次确认的工作。

title.en: Match parts to the existing installation

text.en: We check available pipe, valve and equipment details before ordering parts. Location, connection type and service access affect what can be repaired locally and what needs a wider change.
text.zh: 我们先核对管材、阀门与设备资料再订件，结合位置、连接方式和检修条件判断局部维修或扩大改动。

text.en: Gas service or equipment work is defined for the specific premises. We identify the equipment, required attendance and relevant records separately rather than treating it as an automatic addition to every plumbing visit.
text.zh: 燃气管路或设备工作按具体场所确认，单独核对设备、进场需求和相应资料，不作为每次水管维修的默认附加项目。

title.en: Plan the interruption and the return to use

text.en: We confirm the affected areas, available records, inspection points and any further investigation needed before a repair can be settled.
text.zh: 我们确认影响区域、现有记录、检查点及确定修复前需要的进一步调查。

text.en: We agree the affected facilities and shutdown window, protect surrounding finishes and carry out the confirmed work. Additional findings are recorded for a separate decision.
text.zh: 我们确认设施停用窗口，保护周边饰面并开展约定工作；额外发现记录后另行确认。

text.en: We complete the relevant operating, leakage or drainage checks for the work performed and record what has been returned to use.
text.zh: 我们按实际工作开展相应运行、漏水或排水检查，记录已恢复使用的部分。

title.en: What changes the scope and cost
title.zh: 影响范围与费用的因素

text.en: Accessible defects can be scoped differently from buried or concealed faults. Investigation, opening-up and reinstatement are identified where required.
text.zh: 可见缺陷与埋设、隐蔽故障的确认方式不同；需要时分别列明调查、打开检查和恢复。

text.en: Parts availability, affected outlets, shutdown arrangements, access and the work needed around the pipework all influence the quotation.
text.zh: 配件供应、影响出水点、停用、进场及管线周边工作都会影响报价。

title.en: Useful records for the next maintenance decision
title.zh: 为后续维护留下有效记录

paragraphs.en: We record the repaired location, agreed parts and checks, together with any unresolved issue or further investigation. For recurring faults, a clear history helps distinguish a new event from an item already investigated, rather than repeating the same unclear instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录维修位置、约定配件和检查，以及未解决事项或后续调查。反复故障保留清楚记录，有助于区分新情况与已检查项目。

paragraphs.en: Before the visit we agree shut-off windows and alternative facilities if needed. After work we record the affected points, the agreed operational checks and any monitoring or further investigation required.
paragraphs.zh: 进场前约定停用时段，必要时确认替代设施。完工后记录处理点位、约定的运行检查以及仍需观察或继续调查的事项。

q.en: Can a recurring blockage simply be cleared again?
q.zh: 反复堵塞能否只再疏通一次？

a.en: We review the recurrence, affected points and previous work first. The scope may need further investigation to establish why the problem returns before a lasting repair can be defined.
a.zh: 我们先核对复发情况、影响位置和既往工作；可能需要进一步调查原因，才能明确后续修复范围。

q.en: Do you quote the investigation separately?
q.zh: 调查与维修会分别报价吗？

a.en: Where the fault is concealed or not yet defined, we explain the investigation scope first. The repair is then confirmed against the findings, required parts, access and reinstatement.
a.zh: 故障隐藏或尚不明确时，我们先说明调查范围，再结合发现、配件、进场和恢复工作确认维修。

q.en: What should a hotel or café tell you before attendance?
q.zh: 酒店或咖啡馆进场前需说明什么？

a.en: Tell us which facilities are affected, when the symptoms occur, operating hours and any available equipment records. We use that information to discuss access and the interruption to water or equipment.
a.zh: 说明影响设施、发生时点、营业时间及现有设备记录，方便我们安排进场和用水或设备停用。

q.en: What information helps you quote a drainage problem?
q.zh: 排水问题询价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: We use the property address, the affected fixtures or area, when the problem occurs and any available photos to plan the investigation. If the cause is concealed, we explain the investigation scope before quoting the final repair.
a.zh: 我们根据物业地址、受影响设施或区域、故障发生时间及现有照片安排排查。对于隐藏故障，我们先明确排查范围，再确定最终修复报价。

short.en: Plan servicing or fault checks by unit and operating zone.
short.zh: 按机组与运行分区安排保养或故障检查。

intro.en: We organise air conditioning and building equipment maintenance around occupancy, operating hours and equipment access. We check the reported symptoms, available maintenance records and affected zones. We define the work on filters, drainage, controls or equipment before arranging any wider component replacement.
intro.zh: 我们根据入住情况、运营时间及设备位置安排空调与楼宇设备维护，核对故障表现、现有维护记录和受影响区域，先确认过滤、排水、控制或设备相关工作，再安排需要另行确认的部件更换。

kicker.en: Comfort starts with a defined maintenance scope
kicker.zh: 舒适空间，从明确维护开始

deck.en: Air conditioning, condensate and control issues planned by equipment and occupied zone.
deck.zh: 按设备和使用区域，安排空调、冷凝水与控制问题。

lead.en: We organise commercial air conditioning maintenance around the system that serves the space. We review equipment details, fault symptoms and available service records, then distinguish routine maintenance from repair or component replacement. Occupied rooms, rooftop access and shutdown windows are part of the same plan.
lead.zh: 我们围绕服务该空间的实际系统安排商业空调维护，核对设备、症状与既有记录，区分常规保养、维修和部件更换，并将使用中房间、屋顶检修和停机窗口纳入同一计划。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial HVAC maintenance for equipment symptoms, filters, condensate and controls, with site-specific scopes and occupied-area planning.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业空调与楼宇设备维护，按实际设备核对故障、滤网、冷凝水及控制，明确保养范围与使用中区域的进场安排。

title.en: Connect the symptom to the equipment
title.zh: 把使用症状对应到设备

text.en: We identify the affected zones, operating times and equipment serving them. Existing settings, accessible filters and available records help direct the service scope.
text.zh: 我们确认影响分区、运行时间和对应设备，结合现有设置、可检修滤网及记录确定维护范围。

text.en: We review where and when water appears, including accessible condensate arrangements. A ceiling stain may also involve roofing or plumbing, so the investigation follows the observed conditions.
text.zh: 我们核对水出现的位置和时点，包括可检查的冷凝水排放；吊顶水渍也可能涉及屋面或水管，检查以实际情况为依据。

text.en: We record how the issue changes during operation and which controls are involved. We check the equipment information before specifying a service task or replacement part.
text.zh: 我们记录问题随运行变化的情况和相关控制，并核对设备资料后确定维护项目或配件。

title.zh: 把每次进场的内容列清

rows.en: Agreed checks and accessible service tasks.
rows.zh: 约定检查及可检修部位保养。

rows.en: The identified component or wider requirement.
rows.zh: 确认的部件或较大需求。

rows.en: Parts, compatibility and separate work allowance.
rows.zh: 配件、兼容性与单独工作范围。

title.en: The equipment list is a practical starting point

text.en: Model information, location, the area served and previous findings help us prepare. Where records are incomplete, we identify what needs confirming on site rather than applying a generic list to every unit.
text.zh: 型号、位置、服务区域和既往发现有助于准备。资料不完整时，我们标明现场需核对内容，不把统一清单套给所有设备。

text.en: Filters, consumables, controls and replacement components are matched to the equipment. The agreed maintenance tasks reflect the installation and relevant operating information.
text.zh: 滤网、耗材、控制与更换部件需要匹配设备，约定维护项目结合安装和相应运行资料制定。

title.en: Work through the building in a usable sequence
title.zh: 按物业可使用的顺序施工

text.en: We identify indoor and rooftop equipment, access points and the spaces that may be affected by service or shutdown.
text.zh: 我们核对室内及屋顶设备、检修点和维护或停机影响的空间。

text.en: We carry out the agreed maintenance or repair and record findings that require parts, further investigation or a separate decision.
text.zh: 我们完成约定保养或维修，记录需订件、进一步排查或单独确认的事项。

text.en: We check the completed work and agreed operation, then identify the equipment returned to use and any outstanding action.
text.zh: 我们检查已完成工作及约定运行情况，标明恢复使用的设备和待办事项。

title.en: Occupied rooms need a coordinated plan
title.zh: 使用中的房间需要协调安排

paragraphs.en: We discuss guest rooms, meeting spaces, trading areas and equipment access with your manager. Where the system permits, stages can be arranged around different zones. The plan identifies downtime, furniture or ceiling access, surrounding protection and who confirms the area is ready for normal use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与负责人沟通客房、会议室、营业区域和设备检修。系统条件允许时按区域分段，明确停机、家具或吊顶进出、周边保护及区域交还确认人。

title.en: Price the equipment and record the findings
title.zh: 按设备报价，按发现留档

text.en: The number and type of units, access difficulty, condition, agreed tasks and parts influence the scope. Component replacement is distinguished from the routine service allowance.
text.zh: 设备数量与类型、检修难度、现状、约定项目和配件影响范围，部件更换与常规保养分别列明。

text.en: We record serviced equipment, completed tasks and relevant checks. Further work is linked to the equipment and location so your manager can review it against the next maintenance plan.
text.zh: 我们记录已服务设备、完成项目和相应检查，将后续工作对应设备与位置，方便负责人纳入下一次维护计划。

q.en: Is ceiling water always a roof leak?
q.zh: 吊顶滴水一定是屋顶漏水吗？

a.en: No. We consider the timing, affected equipment and accessible condensate arrangements alongside other possible water paths. The investigation scope follows those observations.
a.zh: 不一定。我们结合发生时点、相关设备、可检查冷凝水排放及其他可能水路确定排查范围。

q.en: Can several guest rooms be serviced in stages?
q.zh: 多间客房可以分批维护吗？

a.en: We map the equipment and rooms with your manager. Staging depends on the system and access, and we confirm which rooms or equipment will be unavailable during each part of the work.
a.zh: 我们与负责人对应设备和房间；分批方式取决于系统和检修条件，并明确各阶段需暂停使用的房间或设备。

q.en: Are parts included in a routine service?
q.zh: 常规保养包含所有配件吗？

a.en: We list the agreed tasks and consumables in the scope. Repairs or replacement components identified during attendance are recorded and confirmed separately where they are outside that allowance.
a.zh: 我们在范围内列明项目与耗材；进场发现的维修或更换部件超出原范围时，记录后另行确认。

short.en: Defined maintenance for building protection and access systems.
short.zh: 按明确范围维护建筑防护与出入系统。

intro.en: We organise agreed work to fire protection, security and access systems with the site manager and relevant service providers. We identify the equipment involved, review existing records and coordinate any isolation or access restrictions. Inspection, repair and certification are recorded as separate parts of the scope.
intro.zh: 我们与现场负责人及相关服务方协调消防、安防与门禁工作，核对设备、现有记录及停用要求。检查、维修与认证分别列明范围，确保现场清楚每项工作的安排与交付内容。

kicker.en: Keep the access plan as clear as the work
kicker.zh: 让出入安排与维修范围同样清楚

deck.en: Fire doors, hardware and agreed access or security work coordinated with your site team.
deck.zh: 与现场团队协调消防门、五金及已确认的门禁安防工作。

lead.en: We organise defined maintenance and rectification with the site manager and relevant service providers. We identify the door, equipment or system involved and review existing defect and service records. Inspection, repair, testing and certification remain separately identified parts of the agreed scope.
lead.zh: 我们与现场负责人及相关服务方协调明确的维护和整改，核对门体、设备、系统及既有缺陷记录，并把检查、维修、测试与认证分别列明。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast fire door, access and security maintenance coordination, with defined equipment scopes, compatible hardware, temporary access and service records.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸消防门、门禁与安防维护协调，明确设备范围、五金匹配、临时通行及相应服务记录。

title.zh: 相关系统，分别确认范围

text.en: We review the identified door, closer, hinges, latch and existing defect report. The door assembly and relevant records inform which repair can be included.
text.zh: 我们核对门体、闭门器、铰链、锁舌与缺陷报告，结合整套门结构和记录确定修复范围。

text.en: We identify the affected entrance, hardware and operating issue. Existing equipment details and site arrangements guide the proposed repair and any system coordination.
text.zh: 我们确认出入口、五金和运行问题，根据现有设备和现场安排确定维修及系统配合。

text.en: We define the equipment and work required for the premises. Separate servicing or attendance is arranged where the scope needs the relevant provider.
text.zh: 我们按场所明确设备和工作，范围需要相关服务方时，协调单独保养或进场。

title.en: A door fault is more than one loose part
title.zh: 门的故障需要整体核对

text.en: A door that does not close or latch may involve the leaf, frame, hinges, closer or fixing condition. We inspect how these parts work together before specifying hardware.
text.zh: 门无法关闭或扣合，可能涉及门扇、门框、铰链、闭门器和固定状态；我们整体核对后再选配件。

text.en: We check available product identification and existing documentation. Appearance alone is not a sufficient basis for selecting a replacement within a specified door or access system.
text.zh: 我们核对产品识别和现有资料，在指定门组或门禁系统中，更换不能只依据外观。

title.en: From a single entrance to a rectification list
title.zh: 从单个入口到整改清单

rows.en: Inspect the identified assembly and operation.
Group work by location and access requirements.
rows.zh: 按位置和通行要求集中安排。

rows.en: Door numbers, keys and defect list.
rows.zh: 门编号、钥匙和缺陷清单。

rows.en: Stage the agreed items with relevant providers.
rows.zh: 与相关服务方分段处理确认项目。

rows.en: Existing reports and approved work scope.

title.en: Prepare the temporary access before attendance

text.en: We review the equipment, reported problem, requested work and the records required for that scope.
text.zh: 我们核对设备、问题、所需工作和相应资料要求。

text.en: We coordinate keys, occupants, temporary entry arrangements and any required system interruption with your nominated representative.
text.zh: 我们与指定负责人协调钥匙、使用人员、临时进出方式和系统停用。

text.en: We document completed work and the relevant operating checks, then hand over the applicable records and any further items.
text.zh: 我们记录已完成工作与相应操作检查，交付适用资料和后续项目。

title.en: A scope that distinguishes the different tasks

text.en: Door quantities, hardware identification, retained components, access equipment and product availability affect preparation and attendance.
text.zh: 门数量、五金型号、保留部件、进场设备和产品供应影响准备与施工。

text.en: The quotation identifies the agreed repair and any separately arranged inspection, servicing, testing or certification, including the relevant attendance.
text.zh: 报价列明维修，以及单独安排的检查、保养、测试或认证及相关进场。

title.en: Handover by entrance, item and status
title.zh: 按入口、项目与状态交付

paragraphs.en: We link completed items to the door or equipment identifier. The record distinguishes the work performed, checks undertaken, documents supplied and items awaiting a further decision. Your manager can see which entrances are back in use, what records have been supplied and which items still need a separate visit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们把完成项目对应门或设备编号，分别记录施工、检查、已交资料和待确认事项。负责人可按入口核对恢复使用情况、已交资料及仍需另行进场的项目。

q.en: Can a closer be repaired without replacing the whole door?
q.zh: 闭门器故障是否需要换整扇门？

a.en: We first check the door, frame, hinges, fixing condition and the closer. The proposed work must suit the assembly and existing records, so the scope follows that assessment.
a.zh: 我们先检查门体、门框、铰链、固定状态和闭门器，再结合门组和现有记录确定处理范围。

q.en: How do occupants enter during the work?
q.zh: 施工时住户或员工如何进出？

a.en: We agree a practical temporary arrangement with your site representative before attendance, including any affected entrances and system interruptions. The plan depends on the actual building layout and work.
a.zh: 我们在进场前与现场代表确认临时通行，包括受影响入口和系统停用；安排依据建筑布局与具体工作确定。

q.en: Are repair records the same as certification?
q.zh: 维修记录等同于认证文件吗？

a.en: They serve different purposes. We identify the repair record and any separate inspection, test or certification required for the agreed work, with the relevant service attendance clearly stated.
a.zh: 两者用途不同。我们列明维修记录，以及约定工作涉及的单独检查、测试或认证和对应服务安排。

q.en: Can you include fire door repairs in a maintenance visit?
q.zh: 消防门维修可以纳入一次维护安排吗？

a.en: We review the door, hardware, defect report and required work first. We then confirm the appropriate repair scope and documentation, and coordinate any separate inspection or service attendance that the work requires.
a.zh: 我们先核对门体、五金、缺陷记录及所需工作，再确认合适的修复范围与资料，并协调项目所需的单独检查或服务进场。

short.en: Maintain planting, irrigation zones and shared outdoor paths.
short.zh: 维护绿化、灌溉分区及共享室外通道。

intro.en: We maintain the outdoor areas that guests, customers and staff use every day. We assess planted areas, irrigation, pathways and access needs, then organise a practical scope for grounds care and repairs. For resort and shared properties, we coordinate work around pedestrian routes and facility use.
intro.zh: 我们维护住客、顾客和员工每天使用的户外空间，检查种植区、灌溉、步道及通行需求，再安排园林养护和修复范围。度假与共同物业的工作配合行人路线和设施开放时间进行。

kicker.en: Outdoor spaces with a working maintenance plan
kicker.zh: 户外空间，也有清楚的维护计划

deck.en: Gardens, irrigation and shared grounds maintained around entrances, guests and everyday use.
deck.zh: 围绕入口、住客和日常通行，维护园林、灌溉和共享场地。

lead.en: We look after the outdoor areas that form part of a commercial property’s daily operation. We review planting, irrigation, presentation and pedestrian access together, then separate routine grounds care from repairs or a larger landscape change. The agreed tasks and waste arrangements are clear before attendance.
lead.zh: 我们维护商业物业日常使用的户外区域，结合种植、灌溉、环境和行人通行，区分日常养护、维修和较大景观调整，并在进场前确认项目与绿化废物安排。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial landscaping and irrigation maintenance for gardens, courtyards and shared grounds, with clear task lists, repair scopes and access plans.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业园林与灌溉维护，涵盖花园、庭院及共享场地，明确养护清单、维修范围、通行和交付安排。

title.en: Begin with how the outdoor area is used
title.zh: 先了解户外区域怎样使用

text.en: We review garden edges, planted areas and irrigation beside the routes used by guests, staff and deliveries. The maintenance plan keeps the work area and everyday movement in view.
text.zh: 我们检查住客、员工和送货路线旁的花池边界、种植及灌溉，把作业区域与日常通行一起安排。

text.en: We identify the presentation tasks, planting condition and any repair items. Furniture, facility opening times and equipment access influence how a visit is staged.
text.zh: 我们核对环境养护、植物现状和维修项目，结合家具、设施开放时间及设备进场分段施工。

text.en: We record leaking points, uneven coverage and spray reaching paths or neighbouring surfaces. Existing zones and accessible components help define the investigation and repair list.
text.zh: 我们记录漏水、覆盖不均和喷洒影响步道或邻近表面的情况，结合分区及可检修部件确认排查维修。

title.en: Care, repairs and a garden refresh
title.zh: 日常养护、维修与庭院更新

rows.en: Agreed lawn, garden and presentation tasks.
rows.zh: 约定草坪、花园和环境维护。

rows.en: Areas, task list and visit frequency.
Defined leak, coverage or component work.
rows.zh: 明确漏点、覆盖或部件处理。

rows.en: An agreed change to planting or presentation.
rows.zh: 确认的种植或景观调整。

title.en: Choose materials for the actual site

text.en: We identify the existing arrangement and accessible components before selecting replacements. A changed spray pattern or repeated leak may require checking neighbouring parts and the zone operation.
text.zh: 我们核对现有布置和可检查部件再选更换件；喷洒变化或反复漏水还需核对相邻部件与分区运行。

text.en: Planting changes, mulch and other agreed materials are considered against the existing landscape, exposure and use. Larger paving, drainage or structural work is identified as a separate scope.
text.zh: 种植调整、覆盖物及其他材料结合原有景观、暴露条件和用途确认；较大铺装、排水或结构工作单独列项。

title.en: An ordered visit from inspection to clean-up
title.zh: 从检查到清场的有序进场

text.en: We confirm the priority areas, routine tasks and repair items with your manager before equipment and materials are positioned.
text.zh: 我们先与负责人核对优先区域、日常任务和维修项目，再安排设备材料。

text.en: We carry out the specified grounds and irrigation work, separating completed maintenance from further repair or design requirements.
text.zh: 我们完成确认的园林与灌溉工作，把日常维护与新发现维修或设计需求分开记录。

text.en: We review the completed areas and relevant irrigation operation, then remove the agreed green waste and return access as planned.
text.zh: 我们检查完成区域及相关灌溉运行，清理约定绿化废物，按计划恢复通行。

title.en: Guests and pedestrians stay part of the plan
title.zh: 把住客和行人纳入安排

paragraphs.en: We agree work zones, watering arrangements, equipment movement and temporary route changes around occupied facilities. For a larger courtyard update, the brief identifies which areas remain available and how material deliveries and waste leave the property.
paragraphs.zh: 我们结合使用中的设施确认作业分区、用水、设备运输和临时通道。较大庭院更新还需明确可开放区域、材料送达和废物运出路线。

title.en: A maintenance list you can review
title.zh: 形成可核对的养护清单

text.en: Area, access, planting condition, irrigation faults, materials, visit frequency and green waste quantities affect the scope. Repairs are itemised alongside any regular care arrangement.
text.zh: 面积、进场、植物状态、灌溉故障、材料、频次和绿化废物数量影响范围；维修与定期养护分别列明。

text.en: We record the areas attended, tasks completed and agreed irrigation checks. Any ongoing plant issue, unavailable component or larger change is identified for the next decision.
text.zh: 我们记录服务区域、完成任务和约定灌溉检查，列明持续植物问题、待供配件或较大调整。

q.en: Does regular garden care include irrigation repairs?
q.zh: 定期园林维护包含灌溉维修吗？

a.en: The plan states the routine tasks and agreed irrigation checks. Parts, repairs or wider system changes are itemised so they are not assumed to be included in every maintenance visit.
a.zh: 计划列明日常任务和约定灌溉检查，配件、维修或较大系统改动单独说明。

q.en: Can grounds work take place while a resort is open?
q.zh: 度假村开放时可以做园林工作吗？

a.en: We review the facility layout, guest routes and equipment requirements. Where practical, the work is staged around agreed areas and opening times, with access arrangements confirmed in advance.
a.zh: 我们核对设施布局、住客路线和设备需求，在可行时按区域与开放时间分段，并提前确认通行安排。

q.en: Can you look at paving or drainage beside the garden?
q.zh: 花园旁的铺装和排水也能一起查看吗？

a.en: We can include the reported issue in the site brief. Grounds care, irrigation work and the relevant paving or drainage scope are then clearly separated and coordinated.
a.zh: 可以把相关问题纳入现场需求，再将园林、灌溉和对应铺装或排水范围分开并协调。

q.en: Why does paving stay wet after irrigation?
q.zh: 为什么浇灌后铺装一直湿？

a.en: Overspray, poor drainage or a leak can each contribute. Record the affected zone and when the surface becomes wet.
a.zh: 喷洒外溢、排水不畅或漏点都可能有关。请记录受到影响的分区与表面变湿的时间。

short.en: Clear, maintained signs for visitors, tenants and deliveries.
short.zh: 维护访客、租户与送货人员使用的标识。

intro.en: We inspect, repair and organise replacement of agreed commercial signs and wayfinding elements. We check the surface, fixings, visibility and installation access, then match the work to your existing brand and building requirements. Electrical signage and major changes are separately defined in the scope.
intro.zh: 我们检查、维修并安排更换已确认的商业招牌和导向标识，核对基面、固定件、可视性及安装条件，并配合现有品牌与建筑要求。涉及通电招牌或较大改动时，工作范围单独列明。

kicker.en: Make the next turn easier to find
kicker.zh: 让每一次转向更清楚

deck.en: Entry signs, tenant directories and practical directions, repaired or updated with the building in mind.
deck.zh: 结合建筑实际，维修与更新入口标识、租户目录及行人送货导向。

lead.en: We inspect and organise repairs or replacement for agreed commercial signage. A faded sign face, loose fixing and outdated tenant directory need different work. We confirm the content, dimensions, mounting surface and installation access before materials are ordered.
lead.zh: 我们检查并安排已确认的商业标识维修或更换。褪色面板、松动固定件和过时租户目录的处理各不相同，我们在订料前核对内容、尺寸、基面和安装条件。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial signage and wayfinding maintenance for entrances, directories, parking and deliveries, with artwork, material and installation checks.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业标识与导向维护，涵盖入口、目录、停车和送货标识，核对图稿、材料、固定与安装交付。

title.en: The face is damaged or faded

text.en: We inspect the sign face, edges, retained frame and fixings. The scope distinguishes a replacement panel from work to the supporting assembly or surrounding finish.
text.zh: 我们检查面板、边缘、保留框架和固定件，区分更换面板与支承结构、周边饰面处理。

title.en: The information is out of date

text.en: Tenant names, room directories and directional information are checked against the approved brief. We confirm wording and location before production rather than relying on an old sign as the only instruction.
text.zh: 租户名称、房间目录和方向信息按确认需求核对，制作前确认文字和位置。

title.en: Visitors or deliveries miss the route
title.zh: 访客或送货路线不清楚

text.en: We review the intended approach, destination and existing signs with your manager. The work may involve a coordinated update to several signs rather than changing one isolated arrow.
text.zh: 我们与负责人核对到达方向、目的地和现有标识；需求可能涉及多块标识协同更新。

title.en: Keep useful elements, define the replacement

rows.en: The face, fixing or presentation defect.
Whether the retained frame remains suitable.
An approved schedule of wording and locations.
rows.zh: 确认的文字和位置清单。

title.en: Resolve artwork and materials before ordering
title.zh: 订料前确认图稿与材料

text.en: We work from available artwork and brand files, checking text, dimensions, colours and the agreed finish. This provides a clear reference for replacements across more than one location.
text.zh: 我们结合图稿和品牌文件核对文字、尺寸、颜色及完成效果，为多个位置更新提供统一依据。

text.en: We assess the mounting surface, existing holes, support and exposure. The specification identifies retained fittings, new fixings and any local finish repair around the installation.
text.zh: 我们核对安装基面、原有孔位、支撑和暴露条件，列明保留件、新固定件和周边局部恢复。

title.en: From an approved sign list to installation

text.en: We record the sign locations and dimensions, then settle the approved content and replacement boundaries with your representative.
text.zh: 我们记录位置和尺寸，与指定负责人确认内容及更换范围。

text.en: We confirm materials, delivery, removal and access. Electrical signage and major changes are separately defined and coordinated where included.
text.zh: 我们确认材料、送达、拆除和进场；涉及通电标识或较大变化时，单独明确并协调。

text.en: We check the installed wording, position, fixing and agreed appearance, including the local finish around replaced or removed items.
text.zh: 我们核对安装文字、位置、固定和约定外观，包括更换或拆除周边的局部饰面。

title.en: Fit the work around arrivals and trading

paragraphs.en: Entry signs and loading directions often sit beside busy routes. We discuss installation height, access equipment, pedestrian movement, deliveries and any temporary change to the route. The agreed schedule identifies when old signage is removed and the new information becomes available.
paragraphs.zh: 入口和装卸标识常位于繁忙路线旁。我们确认安装高度、设备、行人、送货和临时路线变化，并明确旧标识拆除与新信息启用的安排。

title.en: A quote built from the sign schedule

text.en: Quantity, dimensions, materials, artwork preparation, mounting height and access affect the allowance. Reused supports and new work are clearly distinguished.
text.zh: 数量、尺寸、材料、图稿准备、安装高度和进场影响范围，重复使用的支架与新工作分开列明。

text.en: We record the agreed locations and completed items, with photographs where included. Separate building, electrical or other outstanding tasks remain identified.
text.zh: 我们记录位置和完成项目，按约定提供照片，并列明相关建筑、电气或其他后续工作。

q.en: Can the existing frame be kept?
q.zh: 可以保留原支架只换面板吗？

a.en: We inspect the retained frame, fixing and dimensions first. If it suits the proposed sign, the scope can identify a face replacement and any necessary local preparation separately.
a.zh: 我们先核对框架、固定与尺寸；适合新标识时，明确面板更换和必要局部处理。

q.en: Can directories and parking signs be updated together?
q.zh: 目录和停车导向可以一起更新吗？

a.en: Yes. An approved list of wording, locations and quantities allows the work to be organised together, with different materials or installation conditions identified per sign.
a.zh: 可以。确认文字、位置和数量清单后可集中安排，并逐块标明不同材料和安装条件。

q.en: What artwork should we provide?
q.zh: 需要提供哪些设计资料？

a.en: Provide the current logo or brand files, proposed wording and any existing artwork. We confirm the usable format, dimensions, colour and finish before ordering the agreed replacements.
a.zh: 提供现有标识或品牌文件、所需文字及已有图稿；订料前我们确认可用格式、尺寸、颜色和饰面。

q.en: Can you match existing signs?
q.zh: 可以配合现有标识风格吗？

a.en: We work from your existing artwork, brand files and site measurements. We confirm the proposed material, colour and finish before ordering or installing replacements.
a.zh: 我们根据现有设计文件、品牌资料和现场尺寸安排，订料或安装前确认材料、颜色与饰面。

short.en: Planned cleaning for façades and difficult-to-reach areas.
short.zh: 安排外立面及不易到达部位的清洁。

intro.en: We plan façade and high-access cleaning around the building material, soiling and access method. We assess adjacent windows, coatings, landscaping and pedestrian routes before agreeing the cleaning approach. On coastal buildings, sheltered surfaces can need particular attention because normal rainfall may not wash them.
intro.zh: 我们根据建筑材料、污渍和到达方式安排外立面与高位清洁，先核对周边玻璃、涂层、绿化及人行路线，再确认清洁方案。海边建筑中雨水难以冲洗的遮蔽部位，会纳入重点检查。

kicker.en: Read the surface before cleaning it
kicker.zh: 先读懂表面，再安排清洁

deck.en: Façades and hard-to-reach areas cleaned with materials, access and surrounding activity considered together.
deck.zh: 外立面与高位清洁，同时考虑材料、到达方式和周边使用。

lead.en: We plan exterior cleaning around the actual surface and its condition. Glass, coated cladding, masonry and sheltered details do not all need the same method. We identify the areas, access and protection required, then agree the cleaning approach and water-control arrangements.
lead.zh: 我们根据实际表面与现状安排外部清洁。玻璃、涂层覆层、砌体和遮蔽节点的处理不同；我们确认区域、到达和保护需求，再约定方法与用水管理。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast façade and high-access cleaning planned by substrate, soiling and access, including trial areas, neighbouring protection and cleaning-water arrangements.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸外立面与高位清洁，按基材、污渍和到达方式安排试洗、周边保护及清洁用水管理。

title.en: Identify the surface and what is on it
title.zh: 识别基材，也识别表面问题

text.en: We identify exposed and sheltered areas, including surfaces that receive little natural rain washing. For coated metal, the material and applicable product guidance inform the cleaning scope.
text.zh: 我们核对暴露和遮蔽部位，包括较少被雨水自然冲洗的表面；涂层金属的清洁结合材料及适用产品资料确定。

text.en: We assess the surface, coating and visible marks before selecting a method. The scope distinguishes removable soiling from existing deterioration or damage that requires a repair decision.
text.zh: 我们先检查基材、涂层和可见痕迹，区分可清除污物与需要另行维修的损耗、损伤。

text.en: We check accessible joints and neighbouring materials before work. Their condition affects protection and the suitability of a cleaning approach near openings or sensitive finishes.
text.zh: 我们在清洁前核对可检查接缝及邻近材料，结合其状态安排开口和敏感饰面保护。

title.en: Agree the method after checking the material
title.zh: 核对材料后再确认方法

text.en: Where appropriate, we agree a small test area to review the cleaning result and surface response. Product, pressure and technique are selected for the material rather than assumed from the building height.
text.zh: 需要时先确认小范围试洗，核对清洁效果与表面反应。产品、压力和方法根据材料选择。

text.en: We identify the surfaces included and the treatment proposed for each. Staining that remains, damaged coating and defects revealed during cleaning are recorded separately from the completed cleaning tasks.
text.zh: 我们列明涉及表面和处理方法，将残留污渍、受损涂层及清洁中发现的缺陷与已完成任务分开记录。

title.en: Local entrance or wider façade programme
title.zh: 局部入口，或较大立面计划

rows.en: A shopfront, entrance or agreed canopy area.
rows.zh: 店面、入口或确认的雨棚区域。

rows.en: Surface condition and nearby pedestrian use.

rows.zh: 到达方式与下方区域安排。

title.en: Prepare the site as carefully as the surface

text.en: We identify the included elevations, substrate, existing condition and access restrictions, recording relevant defects before cleaning.
text.zh: 我们确认立面、基材、现状和到达限制，并记录相关既有缺陷。

text.en: We agree the work zone, protect adjacent glazing, landscaping and finishes, and use the specified method with the planned water arrangements.
text.zh: 我们确认作业区域，保护邻近玻璃、园林及饰面，按约定方法和用水安排施工。

text.en: We review the cleaned areas against the scope, clear the agreed equipment and waste, and identify any follow-up repairs.
text.zh: 我们按范围检查清洁区域，清理约定设备废物，并列明后续维修。

title.en: Water, pedestrians and trading belong in the brief
title.zh: 把用水、行人与营业写进需求

paragraphs.en: We discuss cleaning-water collection and disposal arrangements for the site, alongside entries, deliveries and public movement. The presence of a nearby drain does not by itself settle how cleaning wastewater should be managed. These arrangements are confirmed with the agreed method and work area.
paragraphs.zh: 我们结合现场确认清洁水收集与处理，同时安排入口、送货和公共通行。附近有排水口不等于清洁废水可以直接排入，具体安排与方法、作业区域一并确认。

text.en: Surface area, material sensitivity, soiling, test work and the extent of protection affect the cleaning allowance.
text.zh: 表面积、材料敏感程度、污渍、试洗和保护范围影响清洁工作。

text.en: Height, equipment positioning, ground access, water arrangements and trading restrictions affect attendance and staging. The quote states the agreed cleaning limits.
text.zh: 高度、设备位置、地面进场、用水和营业限制影响施工与分段，报价明确清洁边界。

q.en: Is pressure washing suitable for every façade?
q.zh: 所有外立面都适合高压清洗吗？

a.en: No. We check the substrate, coating, joints and existing damage before agreeing the method. A trial area and material-specific product guidance may be needed.
a.zh: 不一定。我们先检查基材、涂层、接缝和既有损伤，再确定方法；必要时试洗并核对对应材料说明。

q.en: Does façade cleaning include windows and sheltered areas?
q.zh: 外立面清洁包含玻璃和檐下吗？

a.en: The quotation names the included surfaces. Glazing, frames, undersides and sheltered details are identified separately where they form part of the agreed scope.
a.zh: 报价会列明表面范围，涉及玻璃、框体、下表面或遮蔽细节时分别确认。

q.en: What happens if cleaning reveals a defect?
q.zh: 清洁中发现损伤怎样处理？

a.en: We record the location and visible condition for review. Any repair or different treatment outside the cleaning scope is separately defined before it proceeds.
a.zh: 我们记录位置和可见状况；超出清洁范围的维修或其他处理，先单独明确再安排。

short.en: Agreed cleaning and waste handling for commercial sites.
short.zh: 安排商业场所清洁及废物处理。

intro.en: We define cleaning and waste work by the area, material and operating requirements of the premises. We coordinate access to shared spaces, amenities and service areas, and identify the waste stream before arranging removal. Routine cleaning and specialist contamination work are quoted as distinct scopes.
intro.zh: 我们按场所区域、材料和运营要求明确清洁与废物处理范围，协调公共空间、卫生间和后勤区域的进场，并在清运前核对废物种类。日常清洁与特殊污染处理分别列明工作范围。

kicker.zh: 清楚的区域，清楚的清洁范围

deck.en: Commercial cleaning and waste work defined by the surfaces, tasks and operating hours of your site.
deck.zh: 按场所表面、清洁任务和运营时间，明确清洁与废物处理。

lead.en: We organise agreed cleaning for shared areas, amenities and service spaces, as well as clean-up after maintenance. We identify the surface, level of soiling, waste type and access before setting the scope. Routine visits, deep cleaning and work-related clear-up are described as different tasks.
lead.zh: 我们安排公共区域、卫生设施、后勤空间及维修后的约定清洁，先核对表面、污损、废物类型和进场，再明确范围；定期、深度和施工后清洁分别列清。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial cleaning and waste coordination with surface-specific scopes, routine and post-maintenance tasks, access planning and clear handover lists.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业清洁与废物处理协调，按表面制定范围，区分定期与维修后清洁，明确进场和逐区交付。

title.en: Name the areas and the actual tasks
title.zh: 明确区域，也明确具体任务

text.en: We agree the included floors, surfaces and fixtures, along with the required presentation and access. A room name alone is not a complete cleaning specification.
text.zh: 我们确认地面、表面和设施范围，以及完成效果和进场条件；仅写房间名称不能替代完整任务清单。

text.en: We identify accessible surfaces, waste streams, temporary storage and collection routes. The brief distinguishes cleaning the area from transporting or disposing of its contents.
text.zh: 我们核对可清洁表面、废物类型、暂存和收运路线，将区域清洁与运输、处置其中物品分别列明。

text.en: We define the agreed work-area clean-up and removal of related waste. Wider premises cleaning, retained stock and unrelated materials are identified separately.
text.zh: 我们明确施工区域清场及相关废物清运，其他物业区域、保留物品和无关材料分别确认。

title.en: Choose the scope that fits the job
title.zh: 选择适合本次工作的范围

rows.en: Maintain agreed areas through regular tasks.
rows.zh: 按固定任务维护确认区域。

rows.en: Address a defined condition or accumulated soiling.
rows.zh: 处理特定状态或积累污损。

rows.en: Surfaces, method and exclusions from routine work.
rows.zh: 表面、方法及与定期工作的区别。

rows.en: Return the agreed work area after maintenance.
Dust, materials, waste and retained items.
rows.zh: 粉尘、材料、废物与保留物品。

title.en: Match the method to the surface

text.en: We check the surfaces included and relevant care information before agreeing products and equipment. Sensitive finishes, nearby furniture and electrical equipment affect protection and working methods.
text.zh: 我们核对表面及相应养护资料后确认产品设备，结合敏感饰面、附近家具和电气设施安排保护与方法。

text.en: We agree the site arrangements for cleaning water and waste handling. Special or uncertain waste types are identified before removal, rather than treated as ordinary general waste.
text.zh: 我们确认清洁水和废物的现场处理安排，特殊或不明类别在清运前核对，不混作普通废物。

title.en: A visit that follows the work list

text.en: We check access, keys, site rules and included areas, then position equipment and protect retained items as agreed.
text.zh: 我们核对进场、钥匙、场所要求和区域，再安排设备并保护保留物品。

text.en: We complete the specified tasks and segregate or collect the agreed waste, recording any condition outside the original allowance.
text.zh: 我们完成指定清洁，分类或收集约定废物，记录超出原范围的情况。

text.en: We check the included areas, address agreed omissions and confirm removal or follow-up items before handing the space back.
text.zh: 我们检查范围内区域、处理约定遗漏，并确认清运或后续事项后交还。

title.en: Work around the people using the premises
title.zh: 围绕使用人员安排清洁

paragraphs.en: We discuss occupancy, toilets and shared facilities, deliveries, storage and the time available for each area. The plan identifies temporary restrictions, equipment movement and the agreed return-to-use conditions. A restaurant, office and shared apartment area need different arrangements even when the floor area is similar.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沟通使用人员、卫生间及共享设施、送货、存放和可用时段，明确临时限制、设备移动及恢复条件。面积相近的餐厅、办公室与公寓公共区域，安排仍有区别。

title.en: An itemised allowance and a checkable result

text.en: Area, surface type, soiling, task frequency, waste quantity, access and collection conditions influence the work. Transport or disposal allowances are stated where included.
text.zh: 面积、表面、污损、频次、废物数量、进场和收运条件影响工作，包含运输或处置时明确列明。

text.en: We record completed cleaning areas and agreed waste tasks, together with remaining items or follow-up attendance. Records reflect the service actually arranged, without implying additional specialist treatment.
text.zh: 我们记录清洁区域、废物任务及待办或回访事项；记录对应实际安排的服务。

q.en: Does every repair include complete premises cleaning?
q.zh: 每项维修都包含全场清洁吗？

a.en: The quote states the included work-area clean-up. Cleaning beyond that area, additional waste and separate deep-cleaning tasks are defined individually so the scope remains clear.
a.zh: 报价说明施工区域清场；超出区域的清洁、额外废物或单独深度清洁分别确认。

q.en: How is a deep clean different from regular cleaning?
q.zh: 深度清洁与定期清洁有什么区别？

a.en: Regular visits follow an agreed recurring task list. A deep clean is scoped against specific surfaces and conditions, including any different equipment, preparation or access required.
a.zh: 定期进场执行重复任务清单；深度清洁针对具体表面与状态，明确所需设备、准备和进场条件。

q.en: Is waste transport and disposal included?
q.zh: 报价包含废物运输和处置吗？

a.en: We identify the waste type, expected quantity and access, then state the agreed collection, transport and disposal allowance. Unidentified or different waste is confirmed before removal.
a.zh: 我们核对废物类型、预计数量和进场，再列明约定收集、运输与处置；不明或不同类别先确认再清运。

short.en: Scope damaged paving, ponding and vehicle access by area.
short.zh: 按区域核定铺装破损、积水和车辆通行。

intro.en: We assess defects in car parks, paved areas and external access routes, then plan the work around vehicles, deliveries and pedestrians. We define the repair area, surface build-up and drainage connections before selecting materials. Larger drainage redesign or structural work is identified separately in the scope.
intro.zh: 我们检查停车场、铺装及室外通道缺陷，按车辆、送货和行人的使用安排施工。在选择材料前确认修复面积、基层及排水连接；涉及较大排水改造或结构工作的项目单独列明。

kicker.en: Keep the site moving, one defined area at a time
kicker.zh: 明确分区，让场所继续运转

deck.en: Paving, concrete, external fixtures and drainage defects planned around vehicles and pedestrians.
deck.zh: 结合车辆与行人，安排铺装、混凝土、室外设施和排水缺陷。

lead.en: We assess the damaged surface and the way the area is used before selecting a repair. A few settled pavers, a broken wheel stop and recurring ponding need different scopes. We consider surface build-up, falls, drainage and access, then agree the stages and return-to-use conditions.
lead.zh: 我们先核对表面损坏及区域用途，再选修复方法。局部铺装沉陷、车轮挡块破损和反复积水的范围不同；我们结合基层、坡度、排水和进场，确认阶段与恢复条件。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast car park and external repairs for paving, concrete, fixtures and drainage defects, with staged access, material requirements and clear handover.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸停车场及室外维修，涵盖铺装、混凝土、固定设施和排水缺陷，明确分区通行、材料和交付条件。

title.zh: 从表面问题检查到基层条件

text.en: We check the repair area, adjacent surface, use and accessible build-up. A local surface patch and work involving the underlying support must be distinguished before the scope is agreed.
text.zh: 我们检查修复区域、邻近表面、用途和可核对构造，在确认范围前区分表面修补与基层处理。

title.en: Water returns to the same area

text.en: We review falls, accessible drainage points and the reported conditions. Clearing debris, repairing an outlet and changing the surface or drainage arrangement are different work options.
text.zh: 我们结合坡度、可检查排水点和发生条件，区分清理、出水口维修与表面或排水布局改动。

text.en: We inspect agreed bollards, wheel stops and their fixing areas. The condition of the surrounding surface informs whether securing or replacing the item also needs local surface work.
text.zh: 我们检查确认的防撞柱、挡块及固定位置，并结合周边表面确定是否需要局部修复。

title.en: Define the repair size before staging it
title.zh: 先明确范围，再安排分段

rows.en: A defined surface or fixture defect.
Several parking, paving or access items.
rows.zh: 多处停车、铺装或通行缺陷。

rows.en: A wider surface or drainage requirement.
Investigation, design needs and separate scope.
rows.zh: 调查、设计需求与单独范围。

title.en: Materials follow the use of the area
title.zh: 材料选择跟随使用条件

text.en: We identify the existing paving or concrete and the condition beneath the affected area. Material selection considers the repair boundary and the connection to retained surfaces.
text.zh: 我们识别现有铺装或混凝土及受影响区域下方条件，结合修补边界与保留表面衔接选择材料。

text.en: The agreed material and method determine the conditions for returning vehicles or pedestrians. We do not assign one generic reopening time to every repair.
text.zh: 车辆或行人恢复使用条件由具体材料与方法决定，不给所有修复套用相同开放时间。

title.en: Keep deliveries and people in the work plan
title.zh: 把送货与行人放进施工计划

text.en: We review pedestrian routes, vehicles, loading and equipment access with your manager, then identify the area and any staged closures.
text.zh: 我们与负责人核对人行、车辆、装卸和设备进场，明确作业区与分段封闭。

text.en: We carry out the agreed removal, substrate or fixing preparation and repair. Further concealed defects are recorded before additional work is settled.
text.zh: 我们完成约定拆除、基层或固定准备和修复，额外隐蔽缺陷先记录再确认。

text.en: We inspect the completed area and relevant fixtures or drainage, then confirm the agreed conditions for removing restrictions and returning the area to use.
text.zh: 我们检查修复区域及相关设施或排水，再确认解除限制和恢复使用的条件。

title.en: The work below and around the surface

text.en: Area, depth, substrate preparation, drainage connections, matching materials and waste influence the repair scope. Wider structural or drainage work is separately identified.
text.zh: 面积、深度、基层、排水连接、材料匹配和废物影响范围；较大结构或排水工作另行列明。

text.en: Phasing, vehicle routes, loading requirements, access equipment and material curing affect attendance. These arrangements are part of the quotation rather than an assumed detail.
text.zh: 分段、行车路线、装卸、设备进场和养护影响施工，并纳入报价安排。

title.en: Record what is ready to use
title.zh: 记录哪些区域已经可用

paragraphs.en: We identify the repaired locations, checks completed and reopening arrangements. Any remaining drainage issue, separate investigation or follow-up work stays on the handover list, so the manager can distinguish completed repairs from the next stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们标明修复位置、已做检查及开放安排，将残留排水问题、单独调查或后续工作保留在交付清单，方便区分完成部分与下一阶段。

q.en: Can a few affected bays be repaired on their own?
q.zh: 可以只修几个受影响车位吗？

a.en: We inspect the defect and surrounding conditions first. Where a local repair is appropriate, the scope identifies the affected bays, access and reopening requirements without assuming the whole car park needs work.
a.zh: 我们先检查缺陷及周边；适合局部修复时，明确车位、进场和开放要求。

q.en: Why does water return after the area is cleaned?
q.zh: 清理后为什么仍反复积水？

a.en: Debris may be only one factor. We review surface falls, accessible outlets and connected drainage to define whether cleaning, repair or a wider change needs to be considered.
a.zh: 积屑可能只是其中一个因素；我们核对坡度、出水口和连接排水，确定清理、修复或较大改动范围。

q.en: When can vehicles use the repaired surface?
q.zh: 修复后什么时候可以停车？

a.en: We confirm this from the specified material, method and site conditions. The work plan states the closure and return-to-use arrangements for that repair, including any staged access.
a.zh: 我们根据材料、方法与现场条件确认，在计划中列明该项修复的封闭与恢复安排，包括分段通行。

short.en: Record what to retain, remove or reinstate before handback.
short.zh: 在交还前列明保留、拆除和恢复事项。

intro.en: We turn a commercial fit-out or make-good brief into an itemised scope. We review existing finishes, tenancy requirements and access, then coordinate strip-out, repairs and reinstatement as agreed. We separate retained elements from removals so your manager can review the work before it starts.
intro.zh: 我们把商业装修或退租恢复要求整理成逐项范围，核对现有饰面、租赁要求和进场条件，再协调已确认的拆除、维修与恢复。保留和拆除项目分别标清，方便负责人在开工前确认。

kicker.en: A clear brief becomes a clear finish
kicker.zh: 清楚的需求，形成清楚的交付

deck.en: Commercial alterations, refreshes and end-of-lease work with retained and removed items clearly defined.
deck.zh: 将商业改造、局部翻新和退租恢复中的保留、拆除与完成项目逐项列清。

lead.en: We turn the proposed work into an itemised scope before organising a commercial fit-out or make-good project. We review the existing condition, tenancy requirements and available plans or photographs. Repairing a local finish, changing a workspace and reinstating a tenancy are handled as distinct briefs.
lead.zh: 我们先把需求整理成逐项范围，再安排商业改造或退租恢复，核对现状、租赁要求和已有图纸照片，并分别处理局部饰面修复、空间调整及租区恢复。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial fit-outs and make-good scopes for partitions, finishes, repairs and reinstatement, with staged access, variations and itemised handover.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业装修改造与退租恢复，明确隔断、饰面、维修和恢复范围，安排分段进场、变化确认及逐项交付。

title.zh: 三类需求，边界各不相同

rows.en: Restore agreed damaged or tired finishes.
rows.zh: 修复确认的损坏或老化饰面。

rows.en: Change agreed partitions or interior elements.
rows.zh: 调整确认的隔断或室内构件。

rows.en: Plans, retained items and operational needs.
rows.zh: 图纸、保留部分和运营需求。

rows.en: Complete an agreed tenancy reinstatement list.
rows.zh: 完成确认的租区恢复清单。

rows.en: Landlord list, condition records and access.
rows.zh: 房东清单、现状记录与进场。

title.en: Separate what stays from what goes
title.zh: 把保留与拆除逐项分开

text.en: We identify the included areas, removal limits and repairs to retained construction. Services within or beside affected elements are recorded for the relevant coordination.
text.zh: 我们标明涉及区域、拆除边界和保留构造修复，并记录其中或旁边需要协调的系统。

text.en: We agree the preparation and finish boundaries, matching requirements and retained items. A local patch may need a wider finishing area depending on the agreed appearance.
text.zh: 我们确认基层处理、饰面边界、匹配和保留项目，结合约定外观判断局部修补是否需扩大饰面范围。

text.en: We map removal, making good around former fixtures, material movement and waste. Items outside the brief remain visible as separate decisions rather than being silently assumed.
text.zh: 我们明确拆除、原固定件周边恢复、材料运输及废物，超出需求的项目另行确认。

title.en: Use the records to resolve the brief
title.zh: 用现有资料把需求说清

text.en: Available drawings, photos and the landlord’s item list help identify ambiguities. We compare the brief with the accessible site condition before confirming quantities and scope.
text.zh: 已有图纸、照片和房东清单帮助发现含糊项；我们结合可检查现状确认数量与范围。

text.en: We confirm specified materials, colours, sheen and matching expectations before ordering. Availability and retained surfaces can affect the work boundary and stage sequence.
text.zh: 订料前确认材料、颜色、光泽和匹配要求；供应及保留表面可能影响边界和施工顺序。

title.en: A sequence from protection to handover
title.zh: 从保护到交付的工序安排

text.en: We agree access, retained items, work zones and necessary service coordination before removals begin. Deliveries and waste routes are included in preparation.
text.zh: 拆除前确认进场、保留项目、作业分区和系统配合，准备材料送达及废物路线。

text.en: We carry out the agreed strip-out, substrate repairs and coordinated work, recording discoveries that change the original scope before further work proceeds.
text.zh: 我们开展约定拆除、基层修复和配合工作，发现改变原范围的情况时先记录并确认。

text.en: We complete the agreed finishes and clean-up, then check the item list with your nominated representative and record remaining actions.
text.zh: 我们完成约定饰面和清场，与指定负责人核对清单并记录剩余事项。

title.en: Plan around the spaces still in use

paragraphs.en: An occupied office or shop needs a different sequence from an empty tenancy. We agree staff and customer routes, noise and dust-producing stages, access restrictions and areas being handed back between stages. Drying, curing and related trade attendance are considered when planning those boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 营业中办公室或店铺与空置租区的顺序不同。我们确认员工顾客路线、噪音扬尘阶段、进场限制和分阶段交还区域，并结合干燥、固化和相关工种进场安排。

title.en: Price the agreed list and close it out
title.zh: 按约定清单报价与销项

text.en: Quantities, preparation, retained conditions, material matching, access, phasing and waste affect the allowance. Investigation and additional findings are distinguished from agreed reinstatement.
text.zh: 数量、准备、保留部分现状、材料匹配、进场、分段和废物影响范围，调查及额外发现与已确认恢复分开。

text.en: We record completed items, agreed appearance and function checks, photographs where included and outstanding work. The handover describes the construction delivered against the approved list.
text.zh: 我们记录完成项目、约定外观和功能检查、相应照片及待办事项，按确认清单说明实际交付工程。

q.en: Can you quote from the landlord’s make-good list?
q.zh: 可以按房东的退租清单报价吗？

a.en: Yes. We compare the list with available records and site conditions, clarify unclear items and prepare an itemised scope for the work to be agreed.
a.zh: 可以。我们结合记录和现场核对清单，明确含糊项目并形成逐项范围。

q.en: Does a patched wall need repainting beyond the patch?
q.zh: 墙面修补是否需要扩大刷漆范围？

a.en: We review the existing finish, patch position and agreed appearance. Preparation, matching and the boundary of repainting are confirmed in the scope rather than assumed to stop at the damaged area.
a.zh: 我们核对原饰面、修补位置和约定外观，明确基层处理、匹配及刷漆边界。

q.en: What happens if removal reveals additional damage?
q.zh: 拆除后发现额外损坏怎样处理？

a.en: We record the finding and explain its effect on the work. Additional repairs, materials or changes are confirmed before being added to the agreed scope.
a.zh: 我们记录发现并说明影响，额外维修、材料或调整在纳入原范围前确认。

short.en: Schedule repairs around check-out, housekeeping and room release.
short.zh: 配合退房、客房清洁和交房安排维修。

intro.en: We organise repairs across guest rooms, reception areas, shared facilities and back-of-house spaces. We agree work zones and attendance with your manager so the scope reflects room access, guest movement and the facilities that need to stay available.
intro.zh: 我们安排客房、接待区、共享设施和后勤空间的维修，与负责人确认施工区域和时间，让工作配合房间进出、住客通行及需要保持开放的设施。

kicker.zh: 住客空间，日常运营。

deck.en: We coordinate guest-room repairs, common-area maintenance and staged updates around room access and the facilities your property needs to keep available.
deck.zh: 我们结合客房进出与设施开放安排，处理客房维修、公共区域维护和分阶段更新。

lead.en: A guest room, a busy lobby and a poolside terrace need different work plans. We separate the defect, the affected area and the conditions for returning it to use. Your manager receives a defined work list, agreed access arrangements and a record by room or shared area.
lead.zh: 客房、繁忙大堂和泳池旁露台，需要不同的施工安排。我们分别确认缺陷、受影响区域和恢复使用条件，为负责人整理工作清单、进场安排及按客房或公共区域划分的记录。

metaDescription.en: We coordinate guest-room repairs, common-area maintenance and staged updates around room access and the facilities your property needs to keep available.
metaDescription.zh: 我们结合客房进出与设施开放安排，处理客房维修、公共区域维护和分阶段更新。

title.en: From guest rooms to shared spaces

text.en: We scope door and hardware faults, damaged wall or ceiling finishes, sealant joints and fixed joinery. Water stains are recorded separately from the source investigation and subsequent finish repairs.
text.zh: 我们确认门及五金、墙面和吊顶饰面、密封接缝与固定木作的维修范围。水渍、漏水源头调查及后续饰面恢复分别记录。

text.en: Reception, corridors, amenities and shared doors are assessed with guest routes in mind. We identify surfaces to protect, access to retain and any temporary work boundaries.
text.zh: 接待区、走廊、卫生设施和公共门的工作结合住客路线安排，明确成品保护、保留通道与临时施工边界。

text.en: We connect agreed roof, drainage, lighting and air-conditioning work with the spaces affected below. Gardens, terraces and pool-surround paving are scoped by area and material.
text.zh: 我们将已确认的屋面、排水、照明和空调工作与下方受影响区域衔接，按区域和材料划分园林、露台及泳池周边铺装工作。

title.en: One room, a defect list or a larger update
title.zh: 单间维修、缺陷清单与较大更新

rows.en: The fault, replacement part and any finish affected
rows.zh: 故障、替换配件及受影响饰面

rows.en: Room numbers, repeated items and material matching
rows.zh: 房号、重复项目与材料匹配

rows.en: Retained items, trade sequence and reopening conditions
rows.zh: 保留项目、工种顺序与重新开放条件

rows.en: A floor or defined shared area
rows.zh: 一个楼层或明确公共区域

title.en: Build the plan around actual access
title.zh: 以实际可进场条件排工序

text.en: We agree who provides keys, which adjacent spaces remain occupied and when power, water or air conditioning may be interrupted.
text.zh: 我们确认钥匙联系人、相邻空间入住状态，以及电、水或空调可以暂停的时间。

text.en: Furniture protection, dust control, noisy tasks and waste movement are included in the work plan. Related tasks are sequenced before final finishes.
text.zh: 施工安排包括家具保护、粉尘控制、噪声工序和废物转运；相关工作完成后再处理最终饰面。

text.en: We record functional checks, cleaning and any drying, curing or follow-up condition that still affects use.
text.zh: 我们记录功能检查、清场情况，以及仍影响使用的干燥、固化或后续处理条件。

title.en: Match the part. Respect the finish.

paragraphs.en: Door hardware models, laminate finishes, paint colours and existing equipment details help define what can be retained and what needs replacement. We identify matching limitations before agreeing the finish scope.
paragraphs.zh: 门五金型号、饰面板、油漆颜色和现有设备资料，有助于确认保留与更换范围。确定饰面工作前，我们会列明材料匹配条件。

paragraphs.en: A maintenance visit and a room refurbishment have different material and access needs. We itemise replacement parts, investigation and additional attendances where they form separate work.
paragraphs.zh: 日常维护与客房翻新对材料和进场的要求不同。需要单独安排的配件更换、调查及再次进场，会分项列明。

text.en: Room or area number, a short fault history and photographs of the item and its surroundings help us group the work.
text.zh: 房号或区域编号、简要故障经过，以及部件和周边照片，可帮助我们归并工作。

text.en: Tell us which rooms can be released, who controls access and the date the area needs to return to use.
text.zh: 提供可交出的客房、进场负责人，以及区域需要恢复使用的日期。

title.en: A clear record for the next shift

paragraphs.en: We identify completed items by room or area, note any parts still required and set out the agreed next attendance. The handover distinguishes completed work from areas awaiting a material requirement or further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按客房或区域列明已完成项目、仍需配件和约定的下一次进场。交付记录清楚区分已完成工作，以及仍等待材料条件或进一步调查的区域。

paragraphs.en: We hand rooms and public areas back by agreed stage, recording what was checked, any cleaning or drying outstanding and who confirms release to guests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按约定阶段交还客房及公共区域，记录检查事项、尚待清洁或干燥的部分，以及谁确认可重新接待客人。

q.en: Can all work fit between check-out and check-in?
q.zh: 所有维修都能安排在退房和入住之间吗？

a.en: We assess the task and materials before agreeing that window. Hardware adjustments may have different requirements from coatings, sealants or work that interrupts shared services. We set out the room-release conditions before booking attendance.
a.zh: 我们先核对任务和材料，再确认能否使用这一窗口。五金调整与涂层、密封材料或影响公共系统的工作，要求各不相同；安排进场前会列明客房交出条件。

q.en: Can several rooms be handled under one scope?
q.zh: 多间客房可以合并安排吗？

a.en: Yes. We group the agreed defects by room, identify repeated parts and arrange batches with your manager. Different faults remain visible as separate items so completion can be tracked room by room.
a.zh: 可以。我们按房号归并已确认缺陷、核对重复配件，并与负责人安排批次。不同故障保留独立条目，便于逐间确认完成情况。

short.en: Group shared-area defects by location and agree resident access.
short.zh: 按位置归类公共区域缺陷，约定住户通行。

intro.en: We work to the scope approved by your body corporate or property representative. We coordinate common-area access, resident notices and contractor attendance, then document what was completed. We identify the relevant building areas and boundaries when defining the job.
intro.zh: 我们按业主委员会或物业代表确认的范围施工，协调公共区域进场、住户通知及施工人员安排，并记录完工内容。确认项目时，我们核对相关建筑区域及工作边界。

kicker.zh: 公共空间，范围清楚。

deck.en: We turn common-area defects into defined work packages, with location records, approved access and completion notes for your property representative.
deck.zh: 我们将公共区域缺陷整理成明确工作包，为物业代表保留位置、获批进场安排和完工记录。

lead.en: We begin with the relevant building areas and the scope approved by your representative. Entry doors, corridors, external surfaces and water-related defects are recorded by location. This gives the property team a clear basis for decisions, resident coordination and staged completion.
lead.zh: 我们先核对建筑部位与物业代表批准的范围，按位置记录入口门、走廊、室外表面和水相关缺陷，为物业团队的决策、住户协调和分阶段交付提供清楚依据。

metaDescription.en: We turn common-area defects into defined work packages, with location records, approved access and completion notes for your property representative.
metaDescription.zh: 我们将公共区域缺陷整理成明确工作包，为物业代表保留位置、获批进场安排和完工记录。

text.en: We scope door hardware, wall and ceiling damage, fixed fittings and agreed amenity repairs. Each item identifies the part affected and the finish or operation to be restored.
text.zh: 我们确认门五金、墙面吊顶、固定设施及约定卫生设施的维修；每项列明受影响部件及需恢复的饰面或功能。

text.en: Reported roof, balcony, façade, paving and drainage issues are separated by building element. Access above, below and through occupied areas is recorded with the defect.
text.zh: 屋顶、阳台、立面、铺装和排水问题按建筑构件区分，缺陷记录同时说明上方、下方及使用中区域的进出条件。

title.en: A defect list that can be priced
title.zh: 可以用于报价的缺陷清单

rows.en: Building, level, door or marked area
rows.zh: 楼栋、楼层、门或标记区域

rows.en: What happens, when it occurs and any previous repair
rows.zh: 问题表现、发生条件及既有维修

rows.en: Defined repair, further investigation or proposed improvement
rows.zh: 明确维修、进一步调查或拟议改善

rows.en: Nominated contact, affected lots and approved work boundary
rows.zh: 指定联系人、受影响单元及获批施工边界

title.en: Confirm the element and the boundary

paragraphs.en: Queensland maintenance responsibilities depend on the scheme and relevant boundaries. We use the property information supplied by your representative when defining the work, including whether the item sits within the approved common-property scope.
paragraphs.zh: 昆士兰共同物业的维护责任与物业计划及相关边界有关。我们依据物业代表提供的资料定义工作，并核对项目是否属于获批公共物业范围。

paragraphs.en: A repair, an investigation and an upgrade are different decisions. We keep them visible in the scope, so a leaking area is not automatically priced as a full replacement and a requested upgrade is not buried inside routine maintenance.
paragraphs.zh: 维修、调查和升级属于不同决定。我们在范围中分别列明，让渗水区域的处理依据调查结果确定，也让新增改善项目单独确认。

text.en: We group related defects while retaining individual location references. Repeated hardware or finish requirements can then be checked together.
text.zh: 我们归并相关缺陷，同时保留每项位置编号，以便统一核对重复五金或饰面要求。

text.en: Your representative coordinates resident notices and access permissions. We identify work zones, material movement and any temporary change to normal routes.
text.zh: 物业代表协调住户通知和进场许可；我们明确施工区、材料搬运及正常路线的临时变化。

text.en: If opened-up areas reveal additional work, we record the finding and seek the nominated decision before adding that scope.
text.zh: 局部打开后如发现额外问题，我们记录现状，并向指定负责人确认后再增加范围。

title.en: What shapes the scope and quote
title.zh: 范围与报价的影响因素

text.en: Existing hardware, coatings, surface profiles and any retained components determine the repair detail and replacement options.
text.zh: 现有五金、涂层、表面型材及保留部件，会影响修复细节和替换选择。

text.en: Height, resident access, the number of affected areas, investigation and staged attendances are identified separately where relevant.
text.zh: 高度、住户进出、受影响区域数量、调查及分阶段进场等因素，会按实际需要分别列明。

paragraphs.en: We match completion notes and photographs to the agreed defect list. Outstanding parts, additional decisions and follow-up observation remain clearly marked, so the property representative can see which items are complete and what still needs action.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将完工说明和照片对应到已确认缺陷清单。未到配件、待定事项与后续观察明确标记，让物业代表清楚哪些项目已完成、哪些仍需推进。

q.en: Can we start with photographs and a committee defect list?
q.zh: 可以先提供照片和委员会缺陷清单吗？
